title: Staffing terms catalog
description: Top-level catalog of dated channel terms plus badge marginal multipliers. This schema defines shape only: it encodes no fee, price, capacity, or date values and no route selection, ranking, probability, or pricing decisions. Reference fields are opaque strings; how they are resolved (including behavior for unknown badges) is implementation, not schema.

terms.description: Dated terms entries, one per channel effective-date pair. Array entries must be pairwise distinct.

badge_multipliers.description: Marginal multipliers keyed by exactly the six contract badge keys.

isoDate.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD with month and day ranges enforced).

finiteNonnegativeNumber.description: A finite nonnegative number. JSON numbers are finite by definition; nonnegativity is enforced by minimum.

feeUsdMonth.description: Monthly fee in USD as a nonnegative number or the literal string "unknown". No actual fee values are defined here.

termsEntry.description: Terms for one channel, effective from a given ISO date. Kind is one of the three supported term kinds; no channel identifiers are enumerated or baked in.

channel_ref.description: Stable opaque reference to a channel defined elsewhere. A string only; never an inline channel definition or id enumeration.

kind.description: Which of the supported term kinds applies: subscription, metered, or local.

effective_from.description: ISO date from which these terms are effective.

fee_usd_month.description: Monthly fee in USD (nonnegative number) or the literal "unknown".

source.description: Nonempty citation for these terms (publisher, page, retrieval note, or equivalent provenance).

decision_price_ref.description: Opaque string reference to the price series used for routing decisions. Distinct in purpose from reporting_price_ref; carries no price value.

reporting_price_ref.description: Opaque string reference to the list price used for reporting and cost accounting. Distinct in purpose from decision_price_ref; carries no price value.

badgeMultipliers.description: Marginal multipliers for badges. Exactly the six contract keys are allowed and all six are required; values are finite nonnegative numbers. Behavior for badges outside this set is implementation, not schema.
